questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 12 cm and a height of 7 cm. Slow down and work it through: what is its area?

block.label: Quick Recall
block.sub: Four options, one answer — keep it fast

questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 12 × 7 = 42 cm². Halving is the step that's easy to skip when rushing.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A closed cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 8 cm. What two areas make up its total surface area?

block.label: Scrub It

questions.why: A cylinder's total surface area is the two circular ends plus the curved side wrapped around — missing either part gives an incomplete total.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: From a while back — what does Piggy's role mainly show in Lord of the Flies?
questions.why: Piggy represents intelligence and logical thinking, but the other boys ignore him, showing how reason loses out once civilisation breaks down.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed container, what happens to total mass during a chemical reaction?
questions.why: In a closed system, mass is conserved — no matter enters or leaves, so total mass before and after the reaction is equal.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is it called when a reaction releases heat and feels warm?
questions.why: A reaction that releases heat into its surroundings, making things feel warmer, is called exothermic.
